title: Preserve Settings state when changing app language
goal: Switching language should update localized presentation without recreating Settings and discarding in-progress provider configuration or triggering redundant credential reloads.
context: SettingsScreen applies `.environment(\.locale, Locale(identifier: appLanguage))` and then `.id(appLanguage)` to the entire screen. A language change therefore replaces the Settings subtree and reruns its `.task`, potentially resetting draft form state and reloading Keychain-backed provider configuration unnecessarily. RootView no longer requires this identity reset after PR #425.
forbidden_changes: Do not change provider credential persistence, endpoint/model values, or Keychain behavior.
Do not change RootView, KernelSession, provider routing, or unrelated screen layouts.
Do not claim physical-device verification from CI alone.
acceptance_criteria: Settings locale changes are driven by the environment without forcing a new Settings view identity.
Provider configuration drafts are not discarded solely because appLanguage changes.
The Settings `.task` is not rerun solely due to a locale identity reset.
All required task-contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA gates pass.
verification: Confirm task-contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI gates.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if locale changes stop updating visible localized strings or Settings behavior regresses.
